notes.title: You Will Die Here Tonight v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.1.0 releases on October 28th, 2024[/h1] 

[h2]This update includes: 
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Professional Mode
[*] Enhanced combat mechanics and enemy behaviors
[*] Localization support for German, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese
[/list]
[h3]What is Professional Mode?[/h3]

[b]Professional Mode[/b] is an entirely new way to play YWDHT!!  

It features an open-ended and remixed version of the game, with deadlier enemies and plenty of surprises along the way. Additionally, this mode includes rankings upon completing the game, with associated unlockable rewards! There are no continues, so once ARIES falls, it's truly game over. 

[b]GOOD LUCK![/b] 

In celebration of this release, [b]the game is 50% off during Steam Scream Fest 2024![/b]

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes: Mark your calendars, You Will Die Here Tonight is coming out on October 31st! After several years of hard work, we can't wait to share the game with you. Get ready to explore Breckenridge Estate, scavenge for weapons and supplies, solve puzzles, and search for a way out -- or die trying!

notes.title: You Will Die Here Tonight Gets a New Demo Every Day During Steam Scream Fest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38932047/4f35093096921be58fe17c7e22ee38ce35daa3a7.png[/img]

Each chapter builds upon the last, focusing on each teammate after they find themselves separated in Breckenridge Estate. Explore the cursed mansion, fight off the undead, slay puzzles with your mind, and uncover new gameplay mechanics every day. Grab each demo at 9am PDT, or wait until October 30th to play them all together.

You Will Die Here Tonight is scheduled for release in 2023.  

For more information visit Steam and keep up to date with development on the official [url=youwilldieheretonight.com]website[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/SpiralBound_Dev]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/WjtBD56aNK]Discord[/url].
